YSRCP mayoral candidate Kolagatla Sravani speaking at an interactive session organised by the Chamber of Commerce in Vizianagaram on Saturday. | Photo Credit: BY ARRANGEMENT
YSR Congress Party mayoral candidate Kolagatla Sravani said on Saturday (October 24, 2026) that Vizianagaram city was developed through the sustained efforts of her father and former Deputy Speaker Kolagatla Veerabhadra Swamy, who focused on civic infrastructure across all routes of the Fort City. In association with Rotary Clubs and CREDAI, the Chamber of Commerce of Vizianagaram held an interactive session with Ms. Sravani, where she assured that she would put in additional effort for the further progress of Vizianagaram.
She said that her party prepared a “Vision-Vizianagaram” document to ensure the systematic development of the city at par with metros, for better living facilities for the people. Mr. Veerabhadra Swamy, who was present at the meeting, requested representatives of all associations to extend their support and vote for his daughter, Sravani. The Chamber of Commerce president Kapuganti Srinivas, CREDAI State vice-president K.S.C. Bose, Rotary Club president Nirmal Kumar Jain, and others were present.
